description: This file implements a string-to-value map data structure with functions for initialization, insertion, retrieval, removal, and management of string keys, supporting features like string duplication and memory pooling.

methods.name: int cmp_strmap_entry(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for strmap entries used in hashmap sorting and lookup, compares entries based on their string keys.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * find_strmap_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Finds a strmap_entry in the given strmap by string key.

methods.name: void strmap_init(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Initializes a strmap to its default state.

methods.name: void strmap_init_with_options(struct strmap * map,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with specific options, including memory pool and string duplication preference.

methods.name: void strmap_free_entries_(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Helper function to free entries in the strmap, optionally freeing values.

methods.name: void strmap_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Clears the strmap and frees entries and values if specified.

methods.name: void strmap_partial_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Partially clears the strmap, freeing entries but not necessarily all data.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * create_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Creates a new strmap entry with the given string and data, handling string duplication and memory pooling.

methods.name: void * strmap_put(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts or updates a value associated with a string key in the strmap.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * strmap_get_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the strmap entry object for a specific key.

methods.name: void * strmap_get(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific string key.

methods.name: int strmap_contains(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a string key exists in the strmap.

methods.name: void strmap_remove(struct strmap * map,const char * str,int free_value)
methods.description: Removes an entry from the strmap, optionally freeing its value.

methods.name: void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t amt)
methods.description: Increments the integer value associated with a string key by a specified amount.

methods.name: int strset_add(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Adds a string to a set (implemented as a map with NULL values) if not already present.
